resources.string: Remote shortcut protection and Home controls. Customize tap and hold actions for remote buttons. Existing branded-button mappings require a hold; short presses never open a store. Tap Home for Switchboard or hold Home for an overlay over the current screen. Window metadata records local recent-app use and identifies Google TV Home for a firmware fallback. This service does not read screen contents or send data. TCL firmware may handle some buttons before Android delivers them.
